scope: Air, same r30 MLO association, five-minute reverse IPv4 TCP/P4, no mirroring; PS diagnostic enabled temporarily

application_result.source: user physical iPerf result; stall question not separately answered

events.scope: Emitted host diagnostics; source firmware notifications and host snapshots do not prove actual air-state or delivery

status1_counter_vs_log.limit: Endpoint snapshots are non-atomic. Missing details can trail the last emitted sequence; no internal sequence gap is not complete event coverage.

limits: Only transitions passing the two-link diagnostic gate are eligible; rate limiting can omit eligible events.
Paired PS durations are host-observed intervals and can contain omitted transitions if coverage has gaps; unpaired boundary states are omitted.
Router uptime and kernel timestamps support coarse alignment; sub-millisecond air-event latency is not established.
No causal driver/firmware fix is inferred from correlation alone.

traffic.interpretation: Different counter units; not a packet offload percentage. Bulk hardware traffic does not call the host TX preparation hook per packet.

awake-repeat.interpretation: Different counter units; not a packet offload percentage. Bulk hardware traffic does not call the host TX preparation hook per packet.

interpretation: No large slowdown reproduced. PS transitions and status1 details occurred with continuing traffic. A simple host-PS flag or status1 presence is insufficient root-cause evidence. No new firmware workaround was applied.
